Question: Assalamualiekum wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuhu, My wife wants me to be clean shaved i.e not have a beard on my face because she says that she feels it to be irritated and comfortable. Can i do so to please my wife? and regrow it maybe later. Is it allowed to do? I have neeyat to keep a beard. Kindly reply back as soon as possible. Jazakallahu Khair. Answer ID: 15154 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1755/1417=H/1430) It is haram to invite the anger of Allah and His Messenger in order to please wife. You must not do it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
